x: Complete with Ted Smith's speed oil, Eric Hall's soap and Jack Goswell's map of Kent, Yours Truly, OTTO VON VICKERS set out on May 3rd for East Berlin, with long-distance runner Jack Haslam and team manager Les Truelove, for the international 25 km. run and walk.
Only a few years ago we weren't figuring in the results, so Jack Goswell thought it was about time we got back to our rightful position. Someone could do the same for the runners.
This is a feat which Jack Goswell couldn't do in London, let alone Paris. Sunday was one of the hottest days of the year and in the morning we basked in the sun (that all too rare thing this summer).

Secretary rubbing shoulders with Tommy Trinder made me think that Jack Goswell's musical talents had been rejected and that our Hon. Treasurer had spared no expense to ensure the happiness and comfort of our team.

I am indebted to Jack Goswell, Alf Harley, Bob Taylor, Dave Sheppard, Bill Lucas, Charlie MacLennon, Alan Mead, Howard Satchell, to the general committee, and in particular to Chris Steer, Bernard Merry, Arthur Penstone and our indefatiguable barmen Frank Webb, Norman Dewberry and Tom Pritchard.

…rave spirit,every single item of Billy Butlin's was tried and tested ; from the open fun-fair in the freezing cold,when Jack Goswell was nearly robbed of his false teeth while tearing around on the "octopus" ,to all the fun and games which would have been nothing without the Harriers all doing their…
Although meeting on the sad occasion of Alf Harley's funeral, Jack Goswell was very pleased to see FRED RICKARDS looking so well and hearty and defying his 73½ years.

Was this the same Bob who had more than once rendered even Jack Goswell speechless, and who had caused John Knifton to flee the country? Was it the same Bob who had led Ken Matthews in the National '20' when Ken was en route to a record breaking performance (the lead changed after several hundred yards)?

Commencing from his early days in the Club with Stan Vickers, Jack Goswell George Beecham and others, Sunday strolls through the Kent and Surrey countryside were the order of the day and are full of sparkle and anecdotes.

Belgrave had a depleted team on and off the road due to John Moullin puncturing and Jack Goswell's car breaking down. Despite this, Bels proved their worth to finish 3rd with Ray Middleton leading us home closely followed by Carl Lawton.
Ted Stimpson offered suggestions as to where Arthur Penny was, Tom Carter hadn't met a coach for years, Jack Goswell flogged football tickets as ever.

These performances would not have been possible without help on the road by others so a tribute to the selfless efforts of Charlie McLennan, Jack Goswell, Bob Barnes, Gerry Cameron, Bob Picton, Carl Lawton and Pat Duncan, and when not competing against him, John Morris.

Sadly, three long-standing members of the Club died during the year: Lovell Cole, Jack Goswell (President 1964/65) and Laurie O'Hara. One matter of Club administration: the Committee have approved a procedure for handling any future disciplinary case.
